about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Garlic Bread Foil Parcels
recipes.summary: Crusty bread slathered with garlic parsley butter, wrapped in foil and heated on the barbecue.
steps: Mash the butter with the garlic, parsley and salt.
Slice the baguette on the diagonal without cutting right through and spread the butter between the slices.
Wrap tightly in foil and heat on the barbecue for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until hot and the butter has melted through.
Open the foil for the last 2 minutes to crisp the crust.
notes: Add grated cheddar between the slices for cheesy garlic bread.
Garlic butter freezes well for 2 months.

recipes.title: Sticky Barbecue Sweet Potato Wedges
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged sweet potato wedges glazed with a smoky, sweet barbecue sauce at the end.

items: 800 g sweet potato, cut into wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and toss the wedges with the oil, paprika and salt on a tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the edges are crisp.
Mix the barbecue sauce and honey, brush over the wedges and roast for 8 to 10 minutes until sticky and caramelised, then scatter with chives.
notes: Do not crowd the tray, or the wedges steam.
Serve with sour cream and chives.

recipes.title: Honey Soy Grilled Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Meaty field mushrooms basted with honey, soy and garlic and grilled until deeply browned.
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, oil, garlic and ginger together.
Brush the mushrooms with the glaze and grill, gill-side up, for 5 minutes.
Flip, brush again and grill for 5 to 6 minutes until deeply browned and tender.
Scatter with sesame seeds and spring onions.
notes: Wipe the mushrooms rather than washing them.
Serve with steak or in a burger bun.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Corn Fritters for the Barbecue
recipes.summary: Golden pan fritters of grated zucchini and corn, cooked on the barbecue flat plate.
steps: Squeeze the zucchini in a clean cloth to remove the water.
Mix the zucchini, corn, flour, eggs, milk, cheddar and chives into a thick batter.
Heat the oil on a barbecue flat plate or pan and cook spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
notes: Food safety: cook the fritters until the centres are firm and no longer wet, especially for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce and yoghurt.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Corn Salad
recipes.summary: Sweet grilled corn kernels tossed with a punchy parsley chimichurri, tomato and red onion.
steps: Grill the corn for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots, then cut the kernels from the cobs.
Blend the parsley, garlic, oil, vinegar, chilli flakes and salt into a loose chimichurri.
Toss the corn, tomatoes and onion with the chimichurri.
notes: Serve warm or at room temperature.
Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Aioli
recipes.summary: A quick garlic mayonnaise with plenty of lemon, perfect with chips, seafood and grilled vegetables.
steps: Stir the garlic into the mayonnaise with the lemon zest, juice and mustard.
Whisk in the olive oil until smooth and glossy.
Rest for 15 minutes so the garlic mellows, then taste for salt.
notes: Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.
Use a microplane to crush the garlic so it blends smoothly.

recipes.title: Sriracha Mayo
recipes.summary: A creamy, medium-hot dipping sauce with lime and a hint of honey, made in two minutes.
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, sriracha, lime juice, honey and garlic until smooth.
Taste and add more sriracha for extra heat.
Chill until cold before serving.
notes: Spread it on burgers or sushi bowls.
Keeps for 1 week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Gochujang Mayo Dip
recipes.summary: A sweet, spicy and savoury Korean-inspired dip for fries, dumplings and fried chicken.
steps: Measure the mayonnaise, gochujang, vinegar, sesame oil and honey into a bowl.
Whisk until completely smooth, then stir in the sesame seeds.
Chill the dip until cold and thick before serving.
notes: Thin with a splash of water for a drizzle.
Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Minted Yoghurt Sauce
recipes.summary: A cooling mint and cucumber yoghurt sauce for grilled lamb, kebabs and spicy curries.
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber to remove the extra water.
Stir the yoghurt, cucumber, mint, garlic, lemon juice, cumin and salt together.
Chill for 15 minutes until cold and the flavours have blended.
notes: Keeps for 3 days in the fridge.
Use as a dip with warm flatbread.

recipes.title: Horseradish Cream
recipes.summary: A sharp, creamy sauce for roast beef, smoked salmon and ham, made with just five ingredients.
steps: Stir the sour cream, horseradish, mustard and lemon juice together in a bowl.
Fold in the chives and chill until cold.
Taste and add more horseradish for a stronger bite.
notes: Keeps for 4 days in the fridge.
Add a pinch of sugar if the horseradish is very sharp.
